supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.03 (p~1e-252); dominant driver, holdout test R2 ~0.76 with X1-X3.
Full regression coef -1.44 (p~1e-165); stable in the 5-variable model.
Interaction coef 0.749, p=1.5e-18, delta_r2 0.074 in X4,X5 model; holdout test R2 rises from ~0.772 to ~0.878 when X4:X5 is added to X1-X5.
Main-effect coef 0.18 (p=1e-5), but its effect is largely conditional on X5 through the X4:X5 interaction.
Main-effect coef 0.15 (p=3e-4), but its effect is largely conditional on X4 through the X4:X5 interaction.

interaction_claims.reason: Highly significant (p=1.5e-18), delta_r2 0.074, and held-out R2 improved from ~0.77 to ~0.88, so it generalizes out of sample.
p=0.86, delta_r2 ~7.6e-6; holdout with the other pairwise products showed no gain.

causal_claims.reason: Strong observational association from regression; no experimental or design evidence for causality.
Association appears via an interaction with X5; observational data cannot establish causality.
